references.phrase: associated prime p of an R-module M
minimal under inclusion among associated primes
references.context: Order theory: minimal element of the subset Ass_R(M) ordered by inclusion

references.disposition: The criterion negates minimality inside Ass_R(M), not inside Spec(R) or the annihilator's complete collection of primes.

review_rationale: Read the embedded-associated-prime criterion relative to the associated prime set of M. Its nonminimality is among associated primes under inclusion, not among all prime ideals of the ring.
